title: Swim in rising water
statementMd:
`grid[r][c]` is the elevation; at time `t` you may swim to any 4-adjacent cell whose elevation is at most `t`. Starting at the top-left, return the least time to reach the bottom-right.

**Example:** `swim_in_water([[0, 2], [1, 3]])` returns `3`.
hints: Dijkstra on the maximum elevation along the path.
